title: 家庭与生活
visual: specific lived-in rooms, ordinary props, natural blocking, and emotionally meaningful spatial distance
performance: small gaze shifts, interrupted tasks, restrained anger, silence, and listener reactions
camera: establish shared space, then over-shoulder coverage, speaker closeup, listener reaction, and prop insert
audio: native room tone, appliances, distant neighborhood sound, natural speech overlap, and little or no score
avoid: continuous shouting, both faces talking to camera, exaggerated sighs, instant emotional resolution
